purpose.domain_detail: Ocesql (Open COBOL ESQL) demonstration program showing PostgreSQL connectivity
purpose.summary: Demonstrates the full lifecycle of embedded SQL in GnuCOBOL via Ocesql: CONNECT to a PostgreSQL database (optionally via PgBouncer), DROP/CREATE a table, INSERT rows using both literals and host variables, COMMIT, and DISCONNECT. Includes an error-handling routine that performs ROLLBACK on PostgreSQL errors.

notable_features: CREATE TABLE with bytea column and inline constraint
PERFORM VARYING loop over host variable array
EVALUATE on SQLCODE for error handling
Commented-out Japanese Shift-JIS/EUC data rows (latin-1 decoded artifacts)
verdict.notes: First line is tab-indented (starts with a tab character) which is unusual for strict fixed-format COBOL but common in GnuCOBOL projects. The file contains commented-out Japanese character data that was decoded as latin-1, causing garbled display; original encoding was likely Shift-JIS or EUC-JP. Long lines (7 over 72) are mostly in SQL blocks. No COPY statements or CALLs; self-contained demo.
